verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a schema-driven structured data extractor that outputs JSON records in a shape you define (unstructured-docs-3, -26, -53), and positions Transform output as ready for databases (unstructured-docs-47). However, its table-specific feature returns each detected table as HTML markup (unstructured-docs-12, -27), which still has to be parsed into rows, and nothing shows table cells mapped to typed columns or loaded without manual cleanup. Missing for 10: documented table-to-typed-rows conversion (column typing, row-level records from tables), evidence of direct database-ready table loading, independent or hands-on corroboration of cleanup-free output.
